body:
First official Brisa release.

A minimal native Windows PDF reader with text highlighting, pen annotations, document tabs and independent side-by-side viewing.

- Renamed the highlighting tool to Subrayar.
- Added Save annotated PDF (Ctrl+Shift+S): export the focused document with embedded highlight and ink annotations, preserving the original.
- Editable Brisa marks still autosave beside the original PDF.

Windows x64: extract Brisa-0.3.1-win-x64.zip and run Brisa.exe. Keep pdfium.dll beside it. Includes MIT license and third-party notices.

Personal project maintained as needed.
